message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday, or a holiday that is observed on a Monday when it lands on a weekend, giving you a three‑day break.)

| # | Holiday | 2023 Date | Observed (if weekend) | Long‑weekend span (days off) | Notes |
|---|---------|-----------|-----------------------|------------------------------|-------|
| 1 | New Year’s Day | **Sunday, Jan 1** | Observed Mon Jan 2 | **Jan 1–3** | 3‑day break (Sunday + observed Monday) |
| 2 | Family Day (Ontario) | **Monday, Feb 20** | – | **Feb 18–20** | 3‑day break (Fri‑Mon) |
| 3 | Good Friday | **Friday, Apr 7** | – | **Apr 7–9** | 3‑day break (Fri‑Sun) |
| 4 | Victoria Day | **Monday, May 22** | – | **May 20–22** | 3‑day break (Fri‑Mon) |
| 5 | Canada Day | **Saturday, Jul 1** | Observed Mon Jul 3 | **Jul 1–3** | 3‑day break (Sat‑Mon) |
| 6 | Labour Day | **Monday, Sep 4** | – | **Sep 2–4** | 3‑day break (Fri‑Mon) |
| 7 | Thanksgiving | **Monday, Oct 9** | – | **Oct 7–9** | 3‑day break (Fri‑Mon) |
| 8 | Remembrance Day | **Saturday, Nov 11** | Observed Mon Nov 13 | **Nov 11–13** | 3‑day break (Sat‑Mon) |
| 9 | Christmas Day | **Monday, Dec 25** | – | **Dec 23–25** | 3‑day break (Fri‑Mon) |
|10 | Boxing Day | **Tuesday, Dec 26** | – | **Dec 26** | Only a single day off (no long weekend) |

### Quick‑look summary

| Month | Long‑weekend dates (2023) |
|-------|---------------------------|
| Jan   | Jan 1–3 |
| Feb   | Feb 18–20 |
| Apr   | Apr 7–9 |
| May   | May 20–22 |
| Jul   | Jul 1–3 |
| Sep   | Sep 2–4 |
| Oct   | Oct 7–9 |
| Nov   | Nov 11–13 |
| Dec   | Dec 23–25 |

> **Pro‑tip:** Some provinces have additional holidays that create extra long weekends (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, St. John’s Day in Prince Edward Island, etc.). If you’re targeting a specific province, double‑check the provincial holiday calendar.

### Where to verify

- **Government of Canada – Public Holidays**: <https://www.canada.ca/en/services/benefits/public-pensions.html>
- **Provincial/territorial holiday calendars** (e.g., Ontario: <https://www.ontario.ca/page/ontario-public-holidays>)

Feel free to copy the table into your holiday‑planning app or let me know if you’d like the data in a different format (CSV, JSON, etc.).
